name: QiuZhen-Bench
description:
Benchmarks on advanced math, sourced from yau contest and doctoral qualification exams of QiuZhen College.
The extracted dataset is placed under dataset folder, which is also available on huggingface!
We also provide the required code for reconstruct this dataset on GitHub, you can do this with the following steps. Feel free to make new PRs to help us refine data quality or upload new problems from yau contest or QiuZhen qualification exams!
reputation: A niche academic benchmark composed of advanced contest and doctoral-qualifying problems; useful for testing mathematical reasoning but with limited mainstream adoption.
